import json
import pathlib
import tempfile
import unittest

from loader import read_config, read_lines


class TestLoader(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        folder = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(folder.cleanup)
        self.folder = pathlib.Path(folder.name)

    def test_a_config_with_a_version_loads(self):
        path = self.folder / 'good.json'
        path.write_text(json.dumps({'version': 2}))
        self.assertEqual(read_config(path), {'version': 2})

    def test_a_config_without_a_version_is_refused(self):
        path = self.folder / 'bad.json'
        path.write_text('{}')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_config(path)

    def test_lines_come_back_one_by_one(self):
        path = self.folder / 'lines.txt'
        path.write_text('a\nb\n')
        self.assertEqual(read_lines(path), ['a', 'b'])

import ast
import pathlib

tree = ast.parse(pathlib.Path('loader.py').read_text())
managed = {id(item.context_expr) for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.With) for item in node.items}
loose = [node.lineno for node in ast.walk(tree)
         if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and getattr(node.func, 'id', '') == 'open' and id(node) not in managed]
assert not loose, f'open() outside a with block on lines {loose}'
